set.body:
## Broad goal

Achieve an anatomically convincing real registration produced by reframe4s Flashalign + HalfFlow, saved to disk, and independently verified.

User framing: this is a broad goal, not a concrete implementation task yet. Keep it open and unassigned. The five points below preserve the proposed direction; case selection, anatomical acceptance criteria, evaluation regions, runner design, and task breakdown still need refinement. Numerical targets below are carried forward from the proposal and existing evidence policies, not a newly frozen protocol or a claim of success.

## Provisional five-point plan

1. Choose one real case and define success before tuning. Use the labeled IBSR_01 -> IBSR_02 pair as the proposed development case; retain sub18-to-MNI as the known failure case. Freeze images, masks, geometry, and evaluation labels when the protocol is made concrete. Run ANTs as a reference and set anatomical acceptance thresholds before inspecting our results. Labels stay out of fitting.

2. Build one command that saves the complete registration. Extend the existing image-backed runner to execute Flashalign affine, identity-start HalfFlow, Flashalign-initialized HalfFlow, and ANTs. Save registered NIfTI volumes, transforms in both directions, stage checkpoints, diagnostics, and comparison plates. Reload the saved transforms and verify that they reproduce the saved images.

3. Get Flashalign's global alignment working on the real images. Check orientation, physical coordinates, masks, overlap, and transform direction first. Inspect the affine result across all three planes. Fix capture or geometry problems until brain position, orientation, and extent align convincingly. This becomes the measured baseline for nonlinear improvement.

4. Make HalfFlow improve that alignment without breaking geometry. Start from the verified Flashalign affine. Locate the first stage that produces an invalid deformation: affine handoff, bridge update, pyramid transition, fine optimization, or export. Repair it with a focused reproduction. Change one factor at a time and preserve the topology thresholds. A valid output must also improve anatomical agreement over affine.

5. Deliver and reproduce the successful result. Require acceptable anatomical scores, convincing slice overlays, improvement over affine, zero folded cells, minimum sampled Jacobian >= 0.05, coverage >= 99%, and inverse residual <= 0.2 mm under the declared evaluation policy. Define the exact metrics, regions, and interpretation of these proposed targets before execution. Package the images, transforms, settings, source revision, and receipt; reproduce them from a clean invocation. Then freeze that recipe and test additional pairs, including sub18, with every failure retained.

## Evidence and scope

- Primary method evidence must come from this repository's Flashalign and HalfFlow implementations. External HodgeFlow outputs remain external reference evidence.
- Input images, successful process exit, synthetic results, and incomplete or rejected transforms do not establish a successful acquired-image registration.
- The development pair is development evidence; repeated inspection does not make it a sealed or held-out qualification pair.
- One successful real registration is the immediate outcome sought. It does not satisfy the separate HalfFlow admission gate of 20 predeclared pairs across two independently sourced datasets.
- No implementation subtasks, path reservations, frozen protocol, or scheduling commitments are established by this goal record. Refine and decompose it before assigning executable work.

## Current reference records

- docs/benchmarks/real-world-registration.md
- docs/benchmarks/real-world-registration-visual-qa.md
- docs/benchmarks/flashalign-halfflow-affine-transfer-v1.md
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md

Related existing work to reconcile during refinement, without asserting a dependency order:

- bd-01KZ28VTQNRGVY6XSB35DY7CN3: BasinBridge B7, robust global affine preconditioning.
- bd-01M2B112XTRP60NNA2AMMPDKN8: Flashalign epic.
- bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE: HalfFlow inverse accuracy over the full export boundary.
- sf-01ky3j2w0y7vbezg5cz1mymyke: HalfFlow labeled-cohort validation and performance hardening.
set.title: GOAL: Achieve a reproducible successful real-image registration with Flashalign and HalfFlow
